name: Fayzulla Xoʻjayev
contribution: A Bukharan politician who served as the first head of the Bukharan People's Soviet Republic, which would later form part of the Uzbek Soviet Socialist Republic.

checks.lead: Fayzulla Ubaydulloyevich Xo‘jayev (Uzbek pronunciation: [fæjzuˈlːæ ubæjduˈlːɒjevitʃ xoˈdʒajev]; Uzbek Cyrillic: Файзулла Убайдуллоевич Хўжаев; Russian: Файзулла Убайдуллаевич Ходжаев, romanized: Faizulla Ubaydullayevich Khodzhayev) was a Bukharan politician who served as the first head of the Bukharan People's Soviet Republic, which would later form part of the Uzbek Soviet Socialist Republic.
